objective: Harden the SubagentWorkflow call line the Pi extension draws: strip bidi and zero-width characters, cut without splitting a surrogate pair, and cache the parse per script text.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-launcher (head 68cca8a). workflowCallLine and workflowRenderers in packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts draw the call as a plain line naming the workflow when literalWorkflowName vets the meta fragment. The security re-review noted: the name keeps bidi overrides (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) and zero-width characters (U+200B-U+200F, U+FEFF), which can spoof the line; slice(0, 80) can split a surrogate pair; and the parse runs on every streamed update with no cache. Strip those characters along with the control characters already stripped, cut by code points (or grapheme-safe) to 80, and memoize the name by script text with a small bounded cache (e.g. last value only, since streaming re-renders the same growing call), with tests for each.
constraints: Edit only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Do not run pi or any live model.
Run bunx --no-install mise run build, then bunx --no-install mise run verify; report each exit code (echo $?) and counts.
Write the source diff (no dist) to /home/user/holyagent-notes/launcher-k.diff and give it as diff-file evidence.
Start each evidence line with the criterion text, then a colon.

criteria.text: The drawn name has no bidi or zero-width characters, is cut without splitting a surrogate pair, and the parse is cached, with tests
